main.description: A course taught. One record per course per term, because a CV lists each offering and because role and enrolment change between offerings.

role.description: Kept explicit because 'taught a course' and 'TA'd a course' are routinely conflated on CVs and mean very different things to a hiring committee.

term.description: Term label as printed, e.g. '2025 Spring', '2025年度前期'. Free text: academic calendars are not standardised.

startedAt.description: YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD. Needed for sorting, since `term` is not machine-orderable.

credits.description: String because credit systems differ (ECTS, 単位, semester hours).

language.description: BCP-47. Teaching in a second language is itself a CV-relevant fact.

isNewCourse.description: Whether the person designed the course from scratch, which weighs differently from inheriting one.

materialsUrl.description: Openly released course materials, e.g. a public repository.
